text: Is there any influenza data in the E. coli records here?

No influenza-related infectious agent is reported in Escherichia coli records from this dataset. The infectious agents recorded alongside Escherichia coli data include various strains of Escherichia coli, other organisms such as Klebsiella pneumoniae, Staphylococcus aureus, and Caenorhabditis elegans, as well as synthetic constructs and metagenomes.

The facet search specifically grouped records by infectious agents and found no mention of Influenza virus among the listed entries.
